preflight.law: for every eps: |R_eps(1) - 1| <= 1e-3 AND cos(dW_eps(1), dW_1(1)) >= 0.999 AND |n_1(1) - 0.894284652673395| <= 0.02; failure -> receipt REGIME-UNRESOLVED, stop before any long leg, NOT-ADJUDICABLE, no relaunch without amendment
preflight.digest_law: fresh preflight digests must equal the locked FMEL1 preflight digests; long-leg h = 1 digests must equal the preflight digests; mismatch -> NOT-RUN

bars.0_qualification: h in {1,5,20,100,900}: fresh C == Stage-0 C, fresh e1 == FME1 Z, fresh e1e-2 == FME1 E, bit-exact; h = 1: every arm == its locked FMEL1 preflight digest; mismatch -> NOT-RUN; asserted over the complete set, never vacuous
bars.2_regime_at_H: first match wins: FORGOTTEN if all n_eps(H) <= 0.05; REGIME-UNRESOLVED if preflight failed or any of alpha_global / alpha_low / alpha_high / cosmin / n_eps at H is UNDEFINED; MAGNITUDE-SCALED PERSISTENT if 0.80 <= alpha_low(H) <= 1.20 AND 0.80 <= alpha_high(H) <= 1.20 AND cosmin(H) >= 0.90 AND n_1(H) >= 0.25; NONLINEAR DIRECTION-SHARED if cosmin(H) >= 0.90 and a local slope is outside [0.80, 1.20]; TRAJECTORY-SENSITIVE if alpha_global(H) <= 0.20 AND max(alpha_low, alpha_high)(H) <= 0.40 AND cosmin(H) <= 0.50; else INTERMEDIATE with all four quoted
bars.3_locus: reported: h_lin = last grid h with both local slopes in [0.80, 1.20] and cosmin >= 0.90; h_dec = first grid h with cosmin <= 0.50; h_curve = first grid h with |alpha_low - alpha_high| > 0.20; UNDEFINED excluded; 'not reached' legal
bars.4_function: per arm: NEUTRAL iff |dCE_eps(H)| <= 0.005; HARMED above positively; HELPED above negatively; FUNCTION-NEUTRAL when all three NEUTRAL; no functional inference from path geometry; descriptive over-threshold list + sign pattern
bars.zero_norm_law: as AMENDMENT L75568 §4: UNDEFINED = null + reason, never NaN; alpha_global needs three ln, each local slope two, cosmin three cosines
bars.label: (BAR 2 regime, BAR 4 function) [writer A only, one anchor, one seed lineage, CPU deterministic, eps >= 1e-2; gate descriptive], h_lin / h_dec / h_curve quoted
